name: HDFC Millennia Credit Card

eligibility.notes: Existing HDFC account preferred but not mandatory.

rewards.selected_merchants_note: 5% applies only to Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, PayZapp and SmartBuy. Other online/dining spends earn 1%.
rewards.notes: 5% cashback capped at ₹1,000/month across all 5% categories combined. 5% applies only to ~10 named partner merchants; all other spends earn 1%.

key_benefits: 5% cashback on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato and more
exclusions: No cashback on fuel, EMI transactions, rent, utilities

name: SBI SimplySAVE Credit Card

eligibility.notes: Relatively easier approval; good first credit card option.

rewards.notes: 10X reward points on grocery, dining, movies, departmental stores. 1 RP = ₹0.25.

key_benefits: 10X reward points on grocery, dining, movies and departmental stores
2,000 bonus points on spending ₹2,000 within first 60 days
Low annual fee with easy waiver
exclusions: No reward points on fuel, cash advances, EMI

name: Axis Bank ACE Credit Card

eligibility.notes: One of the most accessible premium cashback cards in India.

rewards.notes: 5% on bill payments & recharges via Google Pay. 4% on Swiggy, Zomato, Ola. 2% on all other spends. No cap on 2% category.

key_benefits: 5% cashback on utility bills and recharges via Google Pay
2% unlimited cashback on all other spends
exclusions: Cashback credited on minimum ₹500 bill payment or ₹200 other transactions

name: American Express Membership Rewards Credit Card
fee_waiver_condition: No fee waiver; reduced to ₹1,500 from Year 2 if you spend ₹1,50,000

eligibility.notes: Amex acceptance limited in India; best for urban users. Strong rewards program.

rewards.notes: 1 MR point per ₹50 spent (= 2 pts per ₹100). Exclusions: fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions, EMI at PoS. Monthly milestone: 1,000 bonus MR points on 4 transactions of ₹1,500+ in a calendar month (separate from base earn; enrollment-based). point_value_inr is an estimate — actual value varies by redemption method (airline miles, hotel points, Pay with Points).

key_benefits: 1,000 bonus MR points every month on 4 qualifying transactions
Points transferable to IndiGo, Air India, Marriott and more
18% GST savings at select partner restaurants
exclusions: Limited acceptance compared to Visa/Mastercard in India
No MR points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions, EMI conversion at PoS
Monthly 1,000 bonus points require enrollment and 4 transactions of ₹1,500+ in the calendar month

name: Amazon Pay ICICI Credit Card

eligibility.notes: Apply via Amazon app. Amazon Prime members get higher cashback. Good lifetime-free option.

rewards.notes: Cashback credited as Amazon Pay balance. 5% for Prime, 3% for non-Prime on Amazon. No cap on cashback.

key_benefits: Lifetime free — no annual or joining fee
5% cashback on Amazon for Prime members (3% for non-Prime)
2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants (100+ brands)
1% on all other spends including utilities
exclusions: Cashback credited as Amazon Pay balance, not transferable to bank
